directive.quote: Every engine job of the old Worker's rust-engine backlog rows works on the new engine, one to one or better.

preserve: namespace.mjs keepStream hashes actual bytes, keeps content-addressed chunks before publishing a finished file and its name, and reuses content already held by this account.
namespace-store.mjs retains file, chunk, span and exact-name metadata in the account's own namespace; native taking uses the existing Files record scopes and object owner.
namespace.mjs contentsAnswer resolves an exact account name or content identity, clamps each byte range to the bounded read window and refuses unavailable stored bytes.
file-tools.mjs contentsCall/readFile consumes bounded ranges through the same namespace reader; a complete native verification composes that existing range owner.
allowed_deltas: The native operator account-files-take walks an explicit local folder without following symbolic links, preserves relative names and streams provider-sized objects instead of sending files through MCP frames. No old Worker directory-walk counterpart is claimed.
The local-source hash pass derives whole-file BLAKE3 and each outgoing object's SHA-256; the provider signed payload rejects a source that changes before sending. The local source is never deleted.
The native operator account-files-verify is an added composition of the existing exact-name resolver and bounded byte reader, rather than an old Worker command with an identical interface.

Verification opens the existing Files store and vault read-only, compares every local and stored byte window, checks both full BLAKE3 streams, checks the local source generation and rechecks stored file/name metadata. It writes no account records or objects.

The physical verifier requires exact response-length evidence, including overlong-object refusal and an empty-object stat witness; ordinary logical streaming keeps its separate existing read contract.

The native streaming regressions exercise the existing AccountFiles::stream_to owner through this file's test fixture, including current caller checks at reads and sink writes. This contract adds no second streaming implementation.
banned_substitutions: A second byte store, duplicate range reader or a whole-file buffer for verification.
A source path or name alone being accepted as proof of identical bytes.
Deleting or changing local source files while taking or verifying them.
Reporting verification success after a changed local generation, retargeted account name, missing physical length witness or mismatched full content identity.
Claiming that synthetic tests establish installation, hosted execution or general account-write health.

baseline.note: Metadata observation of the current target and existing immutable test receipt, recorded at the host's observed local time. Behavioral adaptation and native composition of the pinned retired JavaScript owners; no original adaptation date or source-first byte-copy baseline is claimed.
